allow: Bash(cmd /c "wmic process where ""CommandLine like ''%Algara%''"" get processid,name,CommandLine 2>nul")

Bash(cmd /c "sqlcmd -S . -d Algara -Q ""IF NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID\(''UserSessions''\) AND name = ''TimeZoneOffset''\) BEGIN ALTER TABLE UserSessions ADD TimeZoneOffset int NULL; INSERT INTO __EFMigrationsHistory \(MigrationId, ProductVersion\) VALUES \(''20260402210000_AddTimeZoneOffsetToSessions'', ''9.0.2''\); PRINT ''Column added and migration recorded.''; END ELSE BEGIN PRINT ''Column already exists.''; END""")
Bash(cmd /c "sqlcmd -S . -d Algara -Q ""SELECT name FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID\(''UserSessions''\) ORDER BY column_id""")

Bash(powershell -Command "$conn = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection ''Server=.;Database=Algara;Integrated Security=True;TrustServerCertificate=True''; $conn.Open\(\); $cmd = $conn.CreateCommand\(\); $cmd.CommandText = ""SELECT name FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID\(''UserSessions''\) ORDER BY column_id""; $reader = $cmd.ExecuteReader\(\); while \($reader.Read\(\)\) { Write-Host $reader[''name''] }; $conn.Close\(\)")
